messages:
Maya Patel: Quick heads-up — webinar is LIVE tomorrow (11am PT). Need final social plan for X + LinkedIn: 1 kickoff post, a 3-tweet thread, and a 4-card LinkedIn carousel. Also need the <deck.pdf> for downloads and a short demo clip (15s). Can we confirm owner and drop deadlines? @Liam @Devon @Sarah :hourglass:
Liam O'Neill: I can take X scheduling and the thread. ETA for copy by EOD today? Need tweet hooks + 1 CTA. Also confirm if we should pin the thread during the webinar.
Devon Park: Creative owning deck + clip. I have a near-final Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/webinar-deck
  - I'll export PPT + PDF by 6pm.
  - Clip: I'll trim 0:30 -> 0:45 highlight, export as mp4 720p.
Sarah Kim: SDR routing: confirm form -> HubSpot mapping. Who's field mapping owner? We need UTM + webinar_id in the lead source. If marketing provides final landing URL, we can map now.
Jenna Ortiz: Copy POV: I'll draft 3 variants for the thread (technical, product-led, customer ROI). Want quick A/B on tone — Devon can call out asset hooks. I'll post in Notion for review: https://notion.so/redwood/webinar-copy
Maya Patel: For inbound routing — use /webinar-2026-03 as campaign tag. Sarah, can you confirm HubSpot flow and SLA for SDR follow-up (within 30m?)
Sarah Kim: Yes can do 30m SLA if we enable immediate routing to on-call SDR. Need an Ops ticket for permissions. Also want the form to include a yes/no field for 'interested in Dedicated' so we can route premium leads differently.
Liam O'Neill: Thread outline (draft):
1) Hook: latency/cost problem many teams face
2) Quick stat from benchmark (we have a 2-3x perf delta vs baseline)
3) Demo tease + link to webinar signup
CTA: "Register — limited seats". I'll paste copy shortly.
Maya Patel: Pinning: yes please pin the X thread during webinar and link to registration CG. Also run paid amplify on the kickoff post for 6 hours.
Devon Park: Uploaded assets to the campaign folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folder/webinar-assets-2026
  - deck.pdf (v3)
  - clip.mp4 (0:40 highlight)
  - thumbnail.png (1200x675)
Jenna Ortiz: Posting cadence proposal:
- T-24h: LinkedIn carousel + X kickoff post
- T-3h: 3-tweet thread teaser
- T-10m: Live doorway tweet with RTs
- Post-webinar: recording + TL;DR thread
Anyone want to tweak?
Liam O'Neill: Looks good. One ask: for thread, include a short benchmark stat in tweet 2 and a screenshot image in tweet 3. Devon can export a small graph image (800x400).
Devon Park: Will export chart as png, dropping into drive in 15m.
ops-bot: Reminder: Please open a permissions ticket for HubSpot route by 18:00 to meet SLA — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/MKT-321
Maya Patel: Final checklist:
- Copy variants (Jenna) — due EOD
- Thread copy + schedule (Liam) — due EOD
- Deck + clip exports (Devon) — due 18:00
- HubSpot mapping + ticket (Sarah + ops) — due 18:00
- Paid amplify budget confirmed (Finance) — I'll ping separately
Thanks all :rocket:
